tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Dark is the default: a violet-black night sky for the gem to sit on.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and panels on bg.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the wordmark on bg and surface.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and captions on bg and surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders, dividers and the diamond lattice pattern.

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: Primary brand colour. Logo ribbons on light grounds, emblem and app icon ground, primary buttons. White text on it passes; for small purple text use purple-text.

tokens.name: purple-shade
tokens.usage: Shaded fold of the logo ribbons on light grounds; pressed state of purple.

tokens.name: purple-light
tokens.usage: Shaded fold of the logo ribbons on dark and purple grounds. Never as text on white.

tokens.name: purple-text
tokens.usage: Purple for links and small text on bg and surface.

tokens.name: purple-deep
tokens.usage: Deep purple for hero grounds and pattern on purple. White text only.

tokens.name: purple-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet purple wash for highlights and selected rows. Ink text on it.

tokens.name: gem
tokens.usage: Secondary brand colour, the gem. Accents, highlights, one call to action per view. Pair with black text, never white.

tokens.name: gem-light
tokens.usage: Lit facet of the gem; hover state of gem.

tokens.name: gem-glint
tokens.usage: Gem table, the brightest facet. Decorative only.

tokens.name: gem-shade
tokens.usage: Lower-left gem facet.

tokens.name: gem-deep
tokens.usage: Darkest gem facet; pressed state of gem.

tokens.name: gem-text
tokens.usage: Gem colour for small text on bg and surface.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Brand black. Text on gem and on light grounds, mono logo.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Brand white. Logo ribbons on dark, text on purple and dark grounds.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase tags, buttons and eyebrow labels.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Small games with sharp edges, made by Alek and Alex.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We build tight, replayable games and ship them when they are fun.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon gaps, pattern stroke.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, default gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section spacing and the pattern pitch.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default. The brand is square; signature shapes use a 14% corner chamfer instead of rounding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and small controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and dialogs, the most rounding the brand allows.
